question_en:
The university ergonomics training station plans to use product images from the "UCOP 2026 Ergonomics Equipment List" to create teaching cards for "isolated main keyboards." Review all product rows in this catalog starting from the "Keyboards" heading up to (but not including) the next section, "Pointing Devices." Only images showing a complete typing keyboard alone may be used directly; images showing only a numeric keypad or images showing pointing devices such as a mouse alongside the keyboard require replacement images. Please answer:

Which products fall within this scope? On which catalog page is each located? List them row by row in a table. Which products' catalog images can be used directly for teaching cards? Which products require replacement images?

The answer must include a complete itemized table with "Product—Catalog Page—Judgment," followed by a Q&A section listing separately the products that can be used directly and those that require new images.
